review_description: Robert Biviano is the owner of this business which has been based in Orange for well over 20 years. Has a very good reputation and was recommended to me by a very particular friend of mine who has solar panels at his residence.
I can not comment on the installation as it was due to be installed this week but I have now been told the mid Sept. due to availablitiy of solar cells

In rural area, you need to know if your transformer will accept power input back to the grid, it may trip out your solar system.Second issue is; are the power lines to the house large enough to be able to take the power back to the grid, without blowing your house systems.These are very important issues that Central West Solar  management raised when completing an on site inspection.  No other company was aware of these problems.In other words, it appears that local knowledge may be better.At the moment I am making inquiries about up grading my power lines, they are very old and not large enough to handle the 10kw system.  Once I have upgraded my lines and installed my system I may be able to give a better response.
i chose a more expensive supplier mainly because i wanted a person in town i could turn to if something went wrong. also they supplied good panels.
Rob from Central West Solar was very good and I couldn't be happier with the final result.

I have found the system we had installed by Central West Solar to be excellent in power generation. Installation was very fast. System was making power from the sun 3hrs after the team arrived. Very good team to deal with.
